ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

3. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

4. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

5. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

6. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.

7. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

8. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

9. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

11. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. happiness
